chunks: He will inherit me, and inherit from the family of Jacob; and make him, O Lord, pleasing (to You).
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Zakariya pray for regarding his successor in Surah Mary?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a dual inheritance, where Zakariya (AS) seeks a spiritual successor who carries both his prophetic knowledge and the legacy of the House of Jacob (Banu Yaqub). This supplication is viewed as a precursor to the emergence of the Imams, who are seen as the true inheritors of the Prophets' spiritual authority and divine wisdom. The phrase 'pleasing to God' (Riḍwān) underscores the divine selection and approval inherent in the lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt.
